propositions: Jira issues moved between projects change their KEY but retain an immutable numeric id; when moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party movers, the old key stops resolving and bindings keyed on the stale key orphan live issues.
The binding store persists and resolves by jira_key; when a key lookup 404s, the absence probe retires the issue, causing silent detachment of issues whose moved_issue_key entry was never updated.

Recording the numeric jira_id alongside the key allows fallback resolution by id when a key 404s; on a successful id-based hit with a different key, the binding is re-keyed and the reverse index is updated atomically.
The fix is additive (preserves all key-based paths unchanged and compatible with Cloud); pre-existing bindings without a recorded id degrade safely to the current behavior with no migration required.
The id fallback is only attempted after a key lookup fails, so the happy path (key still resolves) incurs no retry cost and behaves identically to before.
For a genuinely deleted issue, both key and id lookups fail and the issue retires normally; a stale key 404 masquerading as deletion is distinguished by a successful id resolution.
